arabic text: SAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY\nYEH KEHTE THE, SHAH-E-MUZTAR, SAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text: SAKINA I WILL NOT BE THERE\nTHIS WAS THE SAYING OF IMAM HUSSAIN, SAKINA, I WILL NOT BE THERE

arabic text:
WO WAQT AAYEGA, AB TUMPAR,
SAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
YEH KEHTE THE, SHAH-E-MUZTAR,
SAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text: 'SAKINA I WILL NOT BE THERE'\nTHIS WAS THE SAYING OF IMAM HUSSAIN, SAKINA, I WILL NOT BE THERE

arabic text: LAGEGI AAG, JAL JAAYENGE KHAYMEIN BHI, QANAATEIN BHI\nBANANA KHAAK KO BISTAR,\nSAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text: THERE WILL BE FIRE IN THE TENTS AND ALL WILL BE BURNT\nTHE DUST OF KARBALA WILL BE YOUR BED, SAKINA I WILL NOT BE THERE.

arabic text:
MERE SEENE, PE SONEY KE BAJAAYE,
DEKHO SO JAANA
PHUPI AMMA KE ZAANU PAR,
SAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text: INSTEAD OF SLEEPING ON MY CHEST, YOU MUST SLEEP\nON THE CHEST OF YOUR AUNT ZAINAB, SAKINA I WILL NOT BE THERE

arabic text: BASADARMA, JO MAINE DONON KAANON ME PINHAYE THEY\nCHINENGE JAB AAH GAUHAR,\nSAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text: THOSE EARRING WHICH I PUT IN YOUR EAR WITH A GREAT LOVE AND WISHES\nWHEN THOSE EARRING WILL BE PULLED OFF, SAKINA I WILL NOT BE THERE.

arabic text:
LAHU KAANON SE BARSEGA,
SAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
TAMAACHEY RUKH PAY BARSENGE
PHIRAYI JAOGI DAR DAR,
english translation text: THERE WILL BE BLOOD FORM YOUR EARS AND YOU WILL BE SLAPPED ON FACE.\nYOU WILL BE TAKEN AS CAPTIVE AND MOVED AROUND, SAKINA I WILL NOT BE THERE.

arabic text: TUMHARI MAA PHUPHI BEHNON KE SAR SE,\nAAH CHEENEY GAYE KOI MAQNA, KOI CHAADAR,\nSAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text: LOOTER WILL LOOT THE BELONGING FOR YOUR AUNTS AND SISTERS\nWEILL AND COVERINGS, SAKINA I WILL NOT BE THERE.

arabic text: KABHI NAQEY SE, GIR JAOGI RASTEY ME,\nTO GODI ME UTHALEGI MERI MAADAR,\nSAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text: ONCE YOU WILL FALL FORM THE BACK OF THE CAMEL DURING THE JOURNEY.\nYOU WILL BE PICKED UP BY MY MOTHER FATIMA, SAKINA I WILL NOT BE THERE.

arabic text:
YEH KEHTE THE, SHAH-E-MUZTAR,
SAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
WO WAQT AAYEGA, AB TUMPAR,
SAKINA! HAM NAHI HONGEY
english translation text: THIS WAS THE SAYING OF IMAM HUSSAIN, SAKINA, I WILL NOT BE THERE\nTHAT TIME WILL COME SOON, I WILL NOT BE THERE.
